source: Fuyuki Ebata. Causative and passive in Sakha: Focusing on double-accusative causative and impersonal passive. Томский журнал ЛИНГ и АНТР . Tomsk Journal LING & ANTHRO. 2013. 2 (2)
notes: The Sakha reflexive suffix is -(I)n. This suffix creates a new verb stem meaning ‘V oneself’ or ‘V for oneself’. As is evident from (3) and (4), the reflexive suffix does not necessarily reduce verb valency.
en: I poured some vodka (in someone’s glass).
